description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for git rebase behavior, specifically handling broken files, conflicts, missing or duplicate environment variables, and permission issues during rebase operations.

methods.name: create_conflict
methods.description: Sets up a conflicting rebase situation by creating conflicts between branches and attempting a rebase.

methods.name: check_resolve_fails
methods.description: Checks that attempting to continue a rebase after resolving conflicts fails as expected.
